description_en: Creates a replication link for a native replication instance
description_zh: 原生复制实例创建复制链路
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-db-instance-replication --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-bp1234567890abcdef --master-host 192.168.1.100 --master-port 3306 --master-user repl_user --master-password U2VjdXJlUGFzczEyMyE= --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBInstanceReplication

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the `DescribeDBInstances` operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: A unique name for the replication channel. This name identifies the replication link
parameters.help_zh: 复制通道名称，用于标识复制链路
parameters.name: channel_name

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the primary database, which can be an IP address or a domain name
parameters.help_zh: 主数据库主机地址，支持IP或域名
parameters.name: master_host

parameters.help_en: The port of the primary database. For example, the default port for MySQL is 3306
parameters.help_zh: 主数据库端口号，通常为3306（MySQL）
parameters.name: master_port

parameters.help_en: The username for the replication account on the primary database
parameters.help_zh: 主数据库用户名，用于建立复制连接
parameters.name: master_user

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded password for the replication user account
parameters.help_zh: 主数据库密码，用于验证复制用户，需要提前经过Base64编码
parameters.name: master_password
